title: Use `quoteLayerZeroFee` instead of sending all native asset balance as gas fee for `swap` call
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** High, because the wrong value will be sent always  **Impact:** Low, because the `swap` function has a gas refund mechanism  ## Description  Currently in `StargateArbitrum::stargateSwap` when doing a call to the `swap` method of `stargateRouter`, all of the contract's native asset balance is sent to it so it can be used to pay the gas fee. The [Stargate docs](https://stargateprotocol.gitbook.io/stargate/developers/cross-chain-swap-fee) show that there is a proper way to calculate the fee and it is by utilizing the `quoteLayerZeroFee` method of `stargateRouter`.  ##
